title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #20

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many times did the donkey turn aside or stop before she spoke? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Seven
   C. One
   D. Three

2. Why should you not chat with strangers online? (1 mark)
   A. They are always kind
   B. It is fun
   C. They may not be who they say they are
   D. It is free

3. Who ran away from a wrong situation and was wise? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Nicodemus
   D. Balaam

4. Who visited Jesus at night? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Nicodemus
   C. Zacchaeus
   D. Samson

5. What should you do if someone offers you a harmful drug? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   C. Try it
   D. Sell it

6. What was Zacchaeus' job? (1 mark)
   A. Chief tax collector
   B. Priest
   C. Shepherd
   D. Fisherman

7. Which is a result of disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Punishment or harm
   B. Reward
   C. Praise
   D. Trust

8. Which of these things was created by God, according to the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Only plants
   B. The sun, moon and stars
   C. Only the sea
   D. Only humans

9. Whom did the angel say was expecting a child in old age? (1 mark)
   A. Ruth
   B. Sarah
   C. Elizabeth
   D. Hannah

10. Which of these is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Saying sorry
   B. Admitting a mistake
   C. Copying in a test
   D. Returning lost money

11. What does Acts 2:38 tell people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Repent and be baptised
   B. Sell everything
   C. Fast for a month
   D. Stay at home

12. Why should we obey teachers? (1 mark)
   A. They are our enemies
   B. For fun
   C. To be punished
   D. They guide us and help us learn

13. What is a good way to limit screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Do your homework first and take breaks
   B. Never sleep
   C. Watch all day
   D. Skip meals

14. Which media can defile a child? (1 mark)
   A. Violent and ungodly movies
   B. Bible stories
   C. Gospel songs
   D. Educational programmes

15. Which of these is a person you can pray for? (1 mark)
   A. Only yourself
   B. No one
   C. Your parents
   D. Only leaders

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe four ways in which children can serve in church. (4 marks)

17. Describe how Jesus responded when the disciples sent the children away. (3 marks)

18. Give three rules for staying safe from strangers. (3 marks)

19. Write the first two lines of the Lord's Prayer. (2 marks)

20. Explain how the story of Samson and the lion shows God's power. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Three
   Balaam struck her three times.

2. C — They may not be who they say they are
   People online can pretend.

3. A — Joseph
   Joseph ran from temptation.

4. B — Nicodemus
   John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

5. B — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

6. A — Chief tax collector
   Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector.

7. A — Punishment or harm
   Disobedience brings trouble.

8. B — The sun, moon and stars
   Genesis 1 says that God made the sun, moon and stars, and also the land, sea, plants and animals.

9. C — Elizabeth
   Mary's relative Elizabeth was expecting a baby.

10. C — Copying in a test
   Copying is cheating.

11. A — Repent and be baptised
   Peter's answer to the crowd.

12. D — They guide us and help us learn
   Teachers care for our progress and safety.

13. A — Do your homework first and take breaks
   Balance is important.

14. A — Violent and ungodly movies
   Harmful media can affect the mind.

15. C — Your parents
   We pray for parents, friends and others.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing in the choir, help clean, welcome visitors, read a verse, take the offering, help in Sunday school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: He told them to let the children come, said the kingdom belongs to them, and blessed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not go with them, do not accept gifts or lifts, do not give personal details, shout for help, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. (The wording "who art in heaven" is also accepted.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Samson had no weapon, but the Spirit of the Lord gave him strength to tear a lion apart. This shows God's power is greater than any danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no weapon, 1 for the Spirit giving strength, 1 for God's power.
